Fee Schedule

Fees as low as 0%

Industry leading fees across all our products

Whether you’re just getting started on your investing journey or you’re a seasoned crypto trader, you’ll find a Kraken product that fits your needs at a competitive price point you’ll love. Browse the table below to learn more about the fee structure for each of our offerings.

Kraken

Instantly buy, sell or convert Bitcoin or other cryptocurrencies  on Kraken.com or via the Kraken App.*

Kraken Fees

When you buy, sell, or convert cryptocurrencies or fiat on Kraken, fees apply. These include:

Trading Fees: Kraken charges a 1% trading fee on instant and recurring trades and a 1.5% fee on custom orders, which are waived for Kraken+ members on trading volume up to $10,000 per month (details below).

Payment Fees: Additional fees may apply depending on your chosen payment method, such as using a credit/debit card, Apple Pay/Google Pay ACH transfer, or your Kraken account balance.
For small balance conversions using the “Convert Small Balances” feature, a fixed 3% fee applies to amounts below the minimum order size.

Spread

When using Kraken’s Instant Buy/Sell Services, including custom and recurring purchases, the price you see includes a spread, the difference between the market rate and the rate you receive. This spread ensures price certainty at the time of order execution.
Kraken may retain any excess spread from a transaction. Please note that the spread may vary for similar transactions. The size of the spread varies based on factors such as: market volatility, asset type, order size and type, Kraken VIP status, and overall account activity.

Kraken+

Zero Trading Fees: Kraken+ members enjoy zero trading fees on up to $10,000 USD (or the local currency equivalent) in monthly trading volume for major currencies (USD, GBP, CAD, AUD, EUR, CHF).
This benefit applies only to trades made through the Buy, Sell, or Convert features on the Kraken app or web, and does not include Spot, Futures, API, or OTC trades on Kraken Pro.

Note: While trading fees are waived, spreads and card processing fees still apply.

*Currently the Kraken App is only available in the countries listed in the “Requirements” section of this article.

On-chain staking utilizes blockchain Proof-of-Stake protocol to generate rewards through a process typically called “staking”.

Benefits of On-chain staking on Kraken:

  • Start earning rewards instantly — no waiting or bonding periods
  • One of the highest returns in the industry
  • Stake your assets in just three clicks from your Kraken balances
  • Instant un-staking when using Flexible terms
  • There are currently no transaction fees for Rewards staking or unstaking. On-chain staking commissions apply and are deducted from the rewards earned on your staked assets.
  • Flexible staking on assets with an on-chain unbonding period and staked assets in our Rewards program is subject to a 20% commission.
  • Bonded staking and flexible staking on assets with no on-chain unbonding period are subject to commissions based on current balances staked per asset.
  • For more information, please see Fees in our On-chain staking support page.

*Availability can be found here. If On-chain staking is not showing as an option on your account, you may not be eligible.

Kraken may adjust its deposit and withdrawal fees in response to changes in the underlying costs, market conditions, or user activity. Clients are encouraged to review the account deposit or withdrawal page on Kraken's website and app for the most current information regarding deposit and withdrawal fees.

  • Kraken’s deposit and withdrawal transaction fees are based on the method and currency used.
  • Funding Fees can be both Static (fixed) and Dynamic (variable) in order to reflect the network and processing fees associated with a specific transaction as well as different costs incurred by Kraken.
  • Kraken may implement a percentage-based fee to accurately reflect different costs incurred by Kraken.
  • Funding Fees can be both coin-denominated or percentage-based.
  • Fees displayed upon confirmation of a transaction are always the fees incurred by clients.
  • For more information please check our article on Cryptocurrency deposit fees and minimums, Cryptocurrency withdrawal fees and minimums, Cash deposit options, and Cash withdrawal options.

Kraken offers commission-free trading for 11k+ stocks and ETFs

  • Zero commission for trading stocks and ETFs.
  • Regulatory agencies may charge fees that are passed to the investor. Learn more here.

*Currently available in the U.S. only

  •  There are no trading fees when purchasing xStocks with USDG or USD on Kraken.
  • The standard 1% instant buy/sell trading fee applies when purchasing xStocks using other assets.
  • To lock in a price, a spread may be included in the asset price for each transaction.

*Availability can be found here. If xStocks is not showing as an option on your account, you may not be eligible.

A simple, flexible way to trade on where you think prices are headed on — without needing to own the underlying asset.

  • A 0.25% fee is applied to the notional value of the trade to open the position.
  • A 0.25% fee is applied to the closed notional value of the trade to close the position.

*Currently available in certain geos

How your tier is determined

Your tier is based on the best of:

  • Your spot trading volume

  • Your futures trading volume

  • Your Assets on Platform (AoP)

Your tier reflects the most favorable of the three measures. So if your futures volume is where you're most active, that now counts toward your spot tier, automatically. If more than one measure qualifies you for the same tier, your rates remain unchanged, qualifying through multiple measures at the same tier does not provide additional benefits.

Our fee tiers are built to reward traders regardless of which product of the Kraken platform they use, thus driving maximum liquidity.

Spot rebates are a new maker fee incentive structure on a select number of lower-liquidity spot pairs.

Designed to improve market structure by stimulating passive liquidity, narrowing spreads, and enhancing overall book depth on recently underperforming pairs. Full fee schedule and eligible pair list are available here.

Your spot rebate fee tier is based on the best of:

  • Your spot trading volume

  • Your Futures volume

  • Your Assets on Platform (AoP)

The measure that qualifies you for the highest tier applies. Holding assets on Kraken can now qualify you for lower trading fees, the more you hold, the lower your rate could be. If more than one measure qualifies you for the same tier, your rates remain unchanged, qualifying through multiple measures at the same tier does not provide additional benefits.

*Volume generated with Instant Buy does not count towards your 30 day volume incentives.

With our competitive stablecoin fee structure, we aim to deliver deep liquidity, tight spreads and minimal slippage.

For more information regarding stablecoin, pegged token & FX pair fees, please see our Support Center article.

All margin fees are applied in addition to volume based trading fees at the opening and closing of margin positions.

Margin rates fluctuate based on market conditions, but your rollover rate will be locked in at the time of order execution. This rate will be displayed on the order form as you fill out your order.

Eligible clients are able to maintain open spot positions on margin for an unlimited duration, as long as margin requirements are met.

• See leverage available for all pairs.
• See margin allowance limits.
• See margin trading fees

Additionally,Kraken may liquidate positions automatically at the current index price of the market, immediately closing the position and realizing any associated losses.

This process includes a 2% liquidation fee as a way to manage risk associated with that market and prevent further losses due to slippage. As these orders do not go through the order book, they do not incur the standard trading fee.

Get started with Kraken Pro

Kraken Pro fee considerations

  • Fees are charged on a per-trade basis.
  • Fees are calculated as a percentage of the trade's quote currency volume (by default). Certain pairs allow the fee to be calculated based on the trade's base currency, which can be specified when ordering using the Fee Currency option.
  • User fee volume levels are measured using the equivalent market value of the listed "Fee Volume Currency" at the time of the trade. Note that this currency may be different from the pair's base or quote currency.
  • User fee volume levels are measured and applicable for trades occurring in the last 30 days only.
  • Discount tiers are assessed after every trade, so you get your discounts when you earn them.
  • Our volume-based discounts are designed to be attainable so investors of all sizes are rewarded for their trades.
  • If you’re not a frequent trader but you do big volume, consider our OTC service for a more cost-effective, personal experience.

Low fees for both makers and takers

Almost all of our cryptocurrency pairs follow the same fee schedule, which incentivizes market makers to increase liquidity - meaning it’s easier for you to execute trades at the price you want.
